newsitem.title: UK: Two Brent dates kept, third deferred to March.
newsitem.headline: Two Brent dates kept, third deferred to March.

text.p: Two Brent cargoes nominated loading dates on Tuesday were kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline, while a third scheduled for end-month loading was deferred to March by the equity holder, traders said.
Stasco and J.Aron kept Brent cargoes loading Feb 26-28, they said.
The original Feb loading programme for Brent scheduled the equivalent of 38 cargoes of 500,000 barrels each and 1.36 million in top ups.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
